limitingCharge.source: CMS, RVU26D file documentation (RVU26D.pdf): 95% of the fee schedule amount for non-participating physicians, limiting charge 115% of that, i.e. 109.25% of the fee schedule amount

crcScreeningConversion.source: 42 CFR 410.152(l)(5)(i): Part B pays 85 percent for CY 2023 through 2026, 90 percent for 2027 through 2029, 100 percent beginning January 1, 2030; medicare.gov/coverage/colonoscopies (15%, deductible does not apply)

therapyKxThreshold.source: CMS, MLN MM14315 / Transmittal 13437, CY 2026 KX modifier threshold amounts

esrd.source: CMS fact sheet, CY 2026 ESRD PPS final rule (November 20, 2025): base rate $281.71

dmeRental.source: 42 CFR 414.229(b)(2)-(3): 10% of purchase price for each of the first 3 months then 7.5% (power wheelchairs 15% then 6%); title transfers after 13 continuous rental months; medicare.gov/coverage/continuous-positive-airway-pressure-devices

medigap.source: medicare.gov, Compare Medigap plan benefits (chart read 2026-10-24)
